compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(None — Rule-5 structural-boundary test that pins the instruction-file contract for task-4's flag-tag case; dd-1/dd-2/dd-3 owned by task-4 where the behavior lives; dd-4 unit-test ownership held by the helper RED test. This task makes task-4's instruction edits verifiable.)

## Implementation
Write tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-flag-case.sh — a RED structural-boundary suite modeled on tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-remediation.sh (awk-scoped section extraction + section-missing guard, RED-on-revert). Cite behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5 by name in the header. awk-scope the flag-tag case region of plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md and assert:
(a) the reserved flag-tag case exists and references the passed-in {feature-flags-marker} dispatch arg;
(b) APPROVED branch instructs emitting a flag-cutover task PAIRED WITH a flag-cleanup task (dd-1);
(c) PROHIBITED branch instructs emitting NO feature-flag task AND recording feature_flags:prohibited WITH the marker's reason (dd-2);
(d) prose instructs reading ONLY the passed-in marker, NEVER story prose / never self-fetching the two-hop lookup (dd-3/boundary);
(e) section-missing guard: empty awk extraction emits a FAIL (no vacuous pass).
chmod +x. Register in repo-root .test-index keyed on the task-decomposer.md source path.
RED requirement: MUST fail against the current task-decomposer.md (no flag-tag case yet) until task-4 lands.

## TDD Test Spec
Given the current task-decomposer.md without a flag-tag case; When test-task-decomposer-flag-case.sh awk-scopes the flag-tag section and asserts the approved/prohibited/read-only-marker directives; Then the suite exits non-zero now and exits zero once task-4 adds the section, with the section-missing guard firing a FAIL on empty extraction.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Test file exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-flag-case.sh
- [ ] Suite is awk-scoped + section-missing guard (no vacuous pass)
  Verify: grep -qE 'awk' tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-flag-case.sh && grep -qiE 'section missing' tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-flag-case.sh
- [ ] Suite asserts read-only-marker boundary (reads passed-in marker, never prose/self-fetch)
  Verify: grep -qiE 'feature-flags-marker|passed-in|story prose|self-fetch|two-hop' tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-flag-case.sh
- [ ] Suite asserts the prohibited branch records feature_flags:prohibited with a reason
  Verify: grep -qF 'feature_flags:prohibited' tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-flag-case.sh && grep -qiE 'reason' tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-flag-case.sh
- [ ] Suite cites behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5 by name
  Verify: grep -qiE 'Rule 5|behavioral-testing-standard' tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-flag-case.sh
- [ ] Suite registered in repo-root .test-index keyed on task-decomposer.md
  Verify: grep -qE 'task-decomposer\.md:.*test-task-decomposer-flag-case\.sh' .test-index
- [ ] RED gate: suite fails against the current task-decomposer.md
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-flag-case.sh; test $? -ne 0

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
